Date: April 30, 2025
Ticker: ACME
Q2 Fiscal Year 2025

Operator: Good afternoon. All participants are in listen-only mode. A question-and-answer session will follow the prepared remarks.
Rita Voss: Welcome to the Acme Robotics first quarter call. During this call we may make forward-looking statements. These are subject to risks and uncertainties.
Acme Corporation reported revenue of $4,200,000,000 for the quarter, up 18 percent from a year ago.
Daniel Okafor: Thanks Rita. Warehouse automation demand was strong this quarter. Our Atlas picker robot shipped to forty new customers.
Gross margin was 52 percent, helped by lower battery cell costs. Supply of servo motors remains tight but is improving.
Revenue: $4.2B was a record for the company.
Priya Raman: Operating expenses were $1,350,000,000. We expect second quarter revenue of $4.5 billion, plus or minus two percent.
Operator: We will now take our first question. The first question comes from Marcus Lee with Northbridge Securities.
Marcus Lee: Can you talk about servo motor supply and when constraints ease?
Daniel Okafor: Servo supply was the main bottleneck. We qualified a second vendor and expect constraints to ease by the third quarter.
Operator: Our next question comes from Elena Park with Harbor Capital.
Elena Park: How should we think about the Atlas picker pricing as competition increases?
Priya Raman: We are holding list pricing. Discounting has been minimal and margins should stay near 50 percent.
